note: Measured on the hosted runners of gate run 42577585956 (2 workers, Xcode 27.1). iPad: 3.2 s per picture on the turned device alone (median of 15 landscape invocations, 2.5 to 4.3) and 3.9 s per picture of wall time with 2 clones (median of 12 portrait invocations, 2.4 to 11.8), so the clone speed-up is 3.2 / 3.9 = 0.82: clones gave no gain. iPhone: 6.9 s of wall time per picture with 2 clones, the median of its 7 attempts (4.0 for the one that finished, up to 8.6; pictures from passed tests x 3.32 pictures per test, crashes and re-runs included), stored as 6.9 x 0.82. No text size measured slower than another (iPad landscape medians: xSmall 3.4, large 3.5, AX5 3.1), so one figure per device. bootFetchMinutes is the median job time outside the invocations (5 to 25); invocationMinutes the median setup of a later invocation or pass (0.7 to 4.7).
